acceptance: A core PR that changes docs/ gets an advisory check reporting whether the site builds from its bundle
A deliberately broken docs link in a test PR makes the check fail; the check is not in the required contexts
Core still contains no JS/TS or package.json
context: Found 2026-10-17 at site-split closeout (follow-up list in site-split-99). Must not become a required context; D17 allows no further ruleset change.
description:
Decision D5 of the site-repo split ADR (docs/internal/adr/adr-site-repo-split.md:25) means a core docs PR that breaks the site build is found only after merge: the site refuses the bundle, keeps the last good site and opens an issue. The ADR names an advisory pre-merge check as a follow-up. No core workflow builds the site before merge; the only reference to benchbox-site in core workflows is the post-merge dispatch in .github/workflows/site-inputs.yml:105-116.

Add a non-required check on core PRs that touch docs/: build the PR's site-inputs bundle and ask the site repo to build it (for example through a dispatch that reports back as a check), without adding Node to core (ADR D9).
